notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Food Chain by exiling another creature you control, adding an amount of mana equal to the creatures mana value plus one that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat.
